title: Roadmap Retrospective & Exec Readout: Sync Pulse and Action Ledger
creator: Ava Patel
description: Summary: Prepare a compact retrospective and executive readout that surfaces last cycle's roadmap outcomes, open trade-offs, and specific asks for leadership commitment. The packet is designed to be consumable in a 20-minute exec readout with a 10-minute Q&A. This ticket tracks artifacts, feedback cycles, and the final action ledger for cross-functional owners.
background: After the last planning cycle we shipped several shims to improve autoscaling latency and rolled out batching optimizations for select model classes. There remains variance between measured SLOs and the runway assumptions used to prioritize Dedicated capacity investments. Leadership requested a concise readout that pairs outcome metrics with concrete asks and fallback lanes.
objectives:
1) Give execs a clear signal on initiative health vs. commitments.
2) Surface 2-3 decision points that require resource or policy changes.
3) Get alignment on 30/60/90-day escalation lanes and any cross-org trade-offs.
4) Commit owners and deadlines for follow-ups.
agenda: Executive one-page: initiative health heatmap (3 min)
Top decision asks and trade-offs (6 min)
Risks, mitigations, and rollback lanes (4 min)
deliverables: Action ledger spreadsheet with owners & due dates
Confluence retrospective with links to PRs and telemetry dashboards
